title: Local models
description: Manage local models for each feature. Required resources are prepared automatically when needed.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.description: Generated content is kept. Using this model again requires another download.

fixedEmbedding: Fixed to preserve existing knowledge indexes.

capabilities.transcription: Turn audio and video into text
capabilities.speechSynthesis: Speech synthesis, voice cloning and design
capabilities.speechAlignment: Align transcript text precisely to audio

modelDescriptions.whisperTiny: Fast and lightweight; lower accuracy on difficult recordings.
modelDescriptions.whisperBase: Fast transcription with balanced size and accuracy.
modelDescriptions.whisperMedium: Higher transcription accuracy with quantized weights.
modelDescriptions.whisperLargeV3TurboQ8: Fast large-model transcription with quantized weights.
modelDescriptions.whisperLargeV3: More accurate transcription with longer processing times.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Asr: Multilingual transcription with strong Chinese and English; word timing comes from alignment.
modelDescriptions.qwen3AsrF16: Full-precision multilingual transcription with strong Chinese and English.
modelDescriptions.mossNano: Lightweight Chinese and English speech with preset voices and voice cloning.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2: Full model for voice cloning and design.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2Bf16: BF16 precision model for voice cloning and design.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2Q8: Voice cloning and design with a smaller model.
modelDescriptions.indexTts2: Expressive voice cloning that speaks each line to a set length — the best fit for dubbing.
modelDescriptions.indexTts2F16: Full-precision IndexTTS2 for the most faithful cloning.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Tts: Multilingual voice cloning across ten languages.
modelDescriptions.qwen3TtsSmall: Compact multilingual voice cloning for smaller machines.
modelDescriptions.cosyVoice3: Voice cloning that follows delivery instructions.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Aligner: Full transcript alignment model; up to five minutes at a time.
modelDescriptions.qwen3AlignerQ8: Lightweight transcript alignment model; up to five minutes at a time.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarization: Lightweight speaker identification with automatic or specified speaker count.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarizationCampplus: Lightweight speaker identification with CAM++ bilingual embeddings.
modelDescriptions.htDemucs: HTDemucs vocal and background separation (Q8); runs on the GPU, media up to six hours.
modelDescriptions.birefnetLite: Default. Lightweight BiRefNet; fast, with fine edges on most photos.
modelDescriptions.birefnetGeneral: Full-size BiRefNet for the most accurate general cutouts; slower and needs more memory.
modelDescriptions.birefnetPortrait: Full-size BiRefNet tuned for people: hair, fur and portrait edges.
modelDescriptions.ben2Base: BEN2 with edge refinement; strong on hair and complex outlines, lighter than full BiRefNet.
modelDescriptions.isnetAnime: For anime, illustrations, line art and stickers.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarizationFull: Full-precision speaker identification with automatic or specified speaker count.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarizationEres2netLarge: Full-precision speaker identification with ERes2Net Large embeddings.
modelDescriptions.htDemucsF16: HTDemucs vocal and background separation at full F16 precision; runs on the GPU, media up to six hours.
modelDescriptions.realEsrganGeneralX4v3: Compact general image upscaling. Native ×4 inference; output can be sized to 2K, 4K or 8K.
modelDescriptions.realEsrganX4plus: Full general image upscaling model; longer CPU processing times.
modelDescriptions.lama: Repairs large areas, completing repeating textures such as walls, sky and grass more naturally.
modelDescriptions.mobileSam: Fast point and box selection with exclusion points. Soft-edged selection; for hair-level detail use background removal.
modelDescriptions.sam2HieraTiny: SAM 2.1 quality point and box selection with the same editing controls; slower on CPU.
modelDescriptions.depthAnythingV2Small: Full-precision relative inverse depth. Near objects appear brighter; this is not a distance measurement.
modelDescriptions.depthAnythingV2SmallUint8: Smaller quantized relative inverse-depth model. Near objects appear brighter; this is not a distance measurement.

selectedVoiceModel: For new reference voices; saved voices are unaffected.
